title.value: SmOOD: Smoothness-based Out-of-Distribution Detection Approach for Surrogate Neural Networks in Aircraft Design
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: SmOOD: Smoothness-based Out-of-Distribution Detection Approach for Surrogate Neural Networks in Aircraft Design

extractions.description: This paper introduces SmOOD, a smoothness-based out-of-distribution detection approach, to co-design a model-dependent OOD indicator with the optimized FNN surrogate, to produce a trustworthy surrogate model with selective but credible predictions in aircraft design optimization.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving aircraft design optimization using machine learning techniques, with the goal of reducing computation time and resource consumption. While efficient aircraft design can contribute to sustainability, it is not the central theme of the paper.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Aircraft industry is constantly striving for more efficient design optimization methods in terms of human efforts, computation time, and resources consumption. Hybrid surrogate optimization maintains high results quality while providing rapid design assessments
